manifest.name: dsh-web-fetch-enhanced
manifest.description: DeepSeek Harness web_fetch with operator-approved non-public destinations (fake-IP proxies, intranet docs) and a provider architecture for future fetch backends

scripts.check: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run lint && pnpm run build && pnpm run test && publint
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm run build && vitest run --config vitest.e2e.config.ts

bundle.text:
# Profile bundle: replace the native HTTP fetch provider in place.
#
# The plugin registers its provider as `http`, the id the shipped `web` row
# already selects with `fetchProvider: http`, so the shared `web` row is left
# untouched. A patch replaces a row's whole config: rewriting one field of
# `web` would drop the other (`searchProvider`) and make web_search ambiguous.
- id: web-fetch-http
  disabled: true

- insert:
    - id: web-fetch-enhanced
      name: dsh-web-fetch-enhanced

readme.text:
> [!IMPORTANT]
> **本仓库已归档，不再维护。** 开发已迁到 [Yurzi/dsh-tool-web-enhanced](https://github.com/Yurzi/dsh-tool-web-enhanced)。npm 包名 `dsh-web-fetch-enhanced` 不变，0.2.0 起由新仓库发布，作为 [dsh-tool-web-enhanced-profile](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-tool-web-enhanced-profile) 的一部分安装，不再单独安装。
>
> 从 0.1.x 升级：先在同一个 profile 里移除本插件（`dsh plugin --profile <profile> remove dsh-web-fetch-enhanced`），再安装 `dsh-tool-web-enhanced-profile`。0.1.x 的设置不会被读取或迁移：设置页会提示并提供“恢复默认设置”，之后在“本机 HTTP”连接里重新填写白名单。详见[从 0.1.x 升级](https://github.com/Yurzi/dsh-tool-web-enhanced#从-01x-升级)。
>
> 下文描述的是 0.1.x，仅供存档。
DeepSeek Harness（DSH）插件。它让 `web_fetch` 访问你明确授权的非公网地址，例如 Clash / Mihomo 的 Fake-IP 网段或内网文档站，其余安全检查全部沿用官方 HTTP 抓取实现。安装后直接替换原生 provider，模型侧的工具名、参数和结果都不变；不配置任何网段时，行为与原生一致。

原生 `web_fetch` 只连接公网单播地址，这是防 SSRF 的边界。下面这些可信目标也会因此被拦截，报 `WEB_BLOCKED_URL`：

- Clash、Mihomo 等代理开启 Fake-IP 后，公网域名被解析到 `198.18.0.0/15`，连接再由代理接管；
- Agent 需要读取内网 wiki、自建文档站等私有网络服务。

本插件提供两层由你配置的例外：

1. **CIDR 白名单**：允许访问的非公网 IPv4 / IPv6 网段；
2. **域名白名单（可选）**：只有这些域名可以使用上面的网段。

公网地址始终照常访问，不受这两项影响。

要求 DSH `>=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0-0`。

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-web-fetch-enhanced
```

随包的 bundle patch 只做两件事：禁用原生的 `web-fetch-http` 行，插入本插件的 `web-fetch-enhanced` 行。共享的 `web` 行保持原样。

- DSH 0.2.1 支持插件热加载（HMR），安装后通常即时生效；未生效时重启 Host。浏览器里看不到设置页时，刷新一次页面。
- **升级**：HMR 下对已安装的包再次 `add` 会返回 `already-installed`。在插件页点“更新”（它会先移除再安装），或手动执行：

```bash
  dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-web-fetch-enhanced
  dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-web-fetch-enhanced@<版本>
  ```

- 从 0.0.x 升级到 0.1.0 有破坏性变化，先读 [CHANGELOG](CHANGELOG.md) 中的升级步骤。
- 移除插件后，原生 `web-fetch-http` 行恢复启用。

打开 DSH Web，进入 **插件 → 增强网页获取**。页面分两组：

- **内网访问**：“允许的网段（CIDR）”和“仅限这些域名（可选）”，每行一条规则；
- **请求**：User-Agent，以及折叠在“限制”里的超时、读取字节数、返回字符数和重定向次数。

整页只有一个“保存”按钮，一次写入所有修改。被你改过的字段显示“已自定义”，旁边的“重置”会移除这项覆盖，恢复继承值。保存后下一次 `web_fetch` 就使用新值，无需重启；已在进行的请求继续使用开始时的配置。离开页面会丢弃未保存的修改。

**Fake-IP**：点击“Clash / Mihomo Fake-IP”按钮，一键加入 `198.18.0.0/15`。它覆盖 Clash / Mihomo 默认的 `fake-ip-range`；如果你的代理用了别的网段，填写实际网段。

**域名第二因子**：Fake-IP 网段可以承载任意域名。如果只想让少数站点使用例外，在“仅限这些域名”中填写：

```text
wiki.example.com
*.docs.example.com
```

`*.docs.example.com` 只匹配子域名，不匹配 `docs.example.com` 本身。

**内网站点**：只放行实际需要的最小网段，例如 `10.20.0.0/16`，不要整段放行 `10.0.0.0/8`。

| 目标地址 | 命中 CIDR | 域名规则 | 结果 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 公网 | 不需要 | 不需要 | 允许 |
| 非公网 | 否 | 任意 | 拒绝 |
| 非公网 | 是 | 未配置 | 允许 |
| 非公网 | 是 | 已配置且命中 | 允许 |
| 非公网 | 是 | 已配置但未命中 | 拒绝 |

页面用与 Host 相同的规则逐行检查输入：

- **错误**会阻止保存，并尽量给出一键修正。例如 `198.18.1.1/15` 带主机位，可改为 `198.18.0.0/15`；`https://wiki.example.com/page` 是 URL，可改为 `wiki.example.com`。重复行也算错误。
- **警告**不阻止保存，只提醒你再确认：网段包含云元数据地址 `169.254.169.254`、包含本机回环地址、范围过宽（IPv4 短于 /8，IPv6 短于 /16），或者是公网网段（公网本就可达，这一行不起作用）。

清空列表并保存，会显式写入空列表，撤销所有继承来的例外；这与“重置”不同。

也可以在 Profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里配置插件行，见 [examples/allowlist.cordis.yml](examples/allowlist.cordis.yml)：

```yaml
- id: web-fetch-enhanced
  config:
    allowCidrs:
      - 198.18.0.0/15

patch 会整体替换该行的 `config`，要保留的字段都要写上。全部字段、默认值和语义见 [配置参考](docs/configuration.zh-CN.md)。

- 插件在 `ctx.web` 注册一个 id 为 `http` 的 fetch provider，占据原生 provider 的位置；`web` 行原有的 `fetchProvider: http` 因此选中本插件。
- 每次请求读取一份配置快照，交给官方 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-fetch-http` 的 `HttpFetchProvider` 执行。URL 规则、同源重定向、代理路由、连接固定、超时、大小上限和 MIME / charset 处理都是官方代码。
- 插件只替换其中的 DNS 解析：完整解析一次，逐个检查所有答案。公网地址放行；非公网地址必须命中 CIDR，配置了域名规则时还要命中域名。任一答案不合规，整个请求被拒绝。经 NAT64 映射的 IPv4 也会检查。
- 通过检查的地址集直接用于连接，不会在检查后再次解析。
- 配置了 CIDR 且本插件正在服务 `web_fetch` 时，插件向模型提供一条运行时上下文，说明已授权的网段和域名，避免模型对内网 URL 直接拒答。

- DSH：`>=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0-0`。0.2.0-rc.2 不再支持，仍在该版本的用户请使用 0.0.12。
- Node.js：`^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`。
- 只支持 DSH 的 RC 版和正式版。Alpha 和开发快照变化频繁、没有稳定 API，不做适配。
- DSH 0.3 系列需要重新评估后才会放开上界。

插件页提示 web_fetch 当前由 “deepseek-fetch-api” 提供 你打开了 **插件 → 内置插件配置 → 网页搜索** 中的“启用新版 Web 搜索 API”。这个开关会把 `web_fetch` 切到 DeepSeek Fetch API，本插件的设置随之不生效。关闭开关即可切回 `http`，也就是本插件。DeepSeek Search / Fetch API 本身不受本插件影响。
web_search 或 web_fetch 报 WEB_PROVIDER_AMBIGUOUS

原因是 `web` 行缺了 `searchProvider` 或 `fetchProvider`。patch 会整体替换一行的 `config`：只写一个字段的 patch 会丢掉另一个，缺失的那项进入自动选择。DSH 0.2.1 默认挂载的 DeepSeek Search / Fetch API provider 始终可用，自动选择因此找到多个候选而失败。0.0.12 的 bundle patch 就是这样导致 `web_search` 失败的。 修复：升级到 0.1.0（不再改写 `web` 行）；用 `dsh --profile web --dump-config` 查看 `web` 行，找到只写了一个字段的 patch，把两个字段都写全。临时规避可以设置环境变量 `DSH_WEB_SEARCH_PROVIDER` / `DSH_WEB_FETCH_PROVIDER`。
升级后 web_fetch 报 WEB_PROVIDER_CONFIGURED_MISSING

0.1.0 默认注册为 `http`，不再是 `http-enhanced`。如果你的 Profile 里还留着 `web.fetchProvider: http-enhanced` 或插件行的 `providerId: http-enhanced`，删掉这些覆盖；确实需要 `http-enhanced` 时，按下面的共存模式配置。
为什么 *.example.com 不匹配 example.com 通配规则只匹配子域名。两者都需要时，分别写 `example.com` 和 `*.example.com`。
为什么跨站跳转被拒绝

只自动跟随同源重定向（协议、主机、端口都相同），每一跳都重新检查。跨源跳转报 `WEB_REDIRECT_BLOCKED`，需要由 Agent 对新地址单独发起一次抓取，避免把对一个目标的信任传给另一个站点。
能否保留原生 provider，与本插件并存 可以，但只在确有组件必须使用原生 `http` provider 时才需要。参考 [examples/coexist.cordis.yml](examples/coexist.cordis.yml)：本插件改用 `providerId: http-enhanced`，重新启用 `web-fetch-http`，并在 `web` 行同时写明 `searchProvider` 和 `fetchProvider`。两个 provider 不能注册同一个 id，否则启动时报 `WEB_DUPLICATE_PROVIDER`。
配置了 HTTP 代理后，白名单还起作用吗 走代理的请求由代理解析域名，Host 不做本地 DNS 检查，这与原生行为相同。白名单作用于直连的请求和 IP 字面量。URL 是 IP 字面量时，插件先检查它：白名单外的非公网地址直接拒绝，不会交给代理。

The npm package `dsh-web-fetch-enhanced` keeps its name; from 0.2.0 it is published from the new repository and installed as part of [dsh-tool-web-enhanced-profile](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-tool-web-enhanced-profile), not on its own.

See [upgrading from 0.1.x](https://github.com/Yurzi/dsh-tool-web-enhanced#从-01x-升级) (in Chinese).
>
> The rest of this page describes 0.1.x and is kept for reference.

A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that lets `web_fetch` reach the non-public addresses you explicitly approve, such as a Clash / Mihomo fake-IP range or an intranet documentation site, while every other safety check stays the official HTTP fetch implementation. Installing it replaces the native provider in place: the model-facing tool name, arguments, and results do not change, and with no ranges configured it behaves exactly like the native provider.

The native `web_fetch` connects only to public unicast addresses. That is the SSRF boundary, and it also blocks trusted targets with `WEB_BLOCKED_URL`:

- with fake-IP enabled, Clash, Mihomo, and similar proxies resolve public domains into `198.18.0.0/15` and take over the connection;
- an agent needs to read an intranet wiki, a self-hosted documentation site, or another private service.

The plugin adds two exception layers that you configure:

Requires DSH `>=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0-0`.

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-web-fetch-enhanced
```

The bundle patch does two things only: it disables the native `web-fetch-http` row and inserts this plugin's `web-fetch-enhanced` row. The shared `web` row is left as it is.

- With DSH 0.2.1 hot reload (HMR) the install usually takes effect at once. If it does not, restart the Host; if the settings page does not appear in the browser, reload the page once.
- **Upgrading**: under HMR, adding an already installed package returns `already-installed`. Use Update on the Plugins page (it removes, then adds), or run:

```bash
  dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-web-fetch-enhanced
  dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-web-fetch-enhanced@<version>
  ```

- Upgrading from 0.0.x to 0.1.0 is breaking; read the upgrade steps in the [CHANGELOG](CHANGELOG.md) first.
- Removing the plugin re-enables the native `web-fetch-http` row.

One Save button writes every change at once. A field you changed shows "Customized"; its Reset removes that override and restores the inherited value. Saved values apply to the next `web_fetch` without a restart; a request already running keeps the configuration it started with. Leaving the page drops unsaved edits.

**Fake-IP**: click "Clash / Mihomo fake-IP" to add `198.18.0.0/15`. It covers the default Clash / Mihomo `fake-ip-range`; if your proxy uses another range, enter that range.

**Hostname second factor**: a fake-IP range can carry any domain. To let only a few sites use the exception, list them under "Only for these hostnames":

```text
wiki.example.com
*.docs.example.com
```

`*.docs.example.com` matches subdomains only, not `docs.example.com` itself.
**Intranet sites**: open only the smallest range you need, for example `10.20.0.0/16`, not all of `10.0.0.0/8`.

| Destination | Inside a CIDR | Hostname rules | Result |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Public | not needed | not needed | allowed |
| Non-public | no | any | refused |
| Non-public | yes | none configured | allowed |
| Non-public | yes | configured, matched | allowed |
| Non-public | yes | configured, not matched | refused |

- **Errors** block saving and, where one correction is meant, offer it in one click. `198.18.1.1/15` has host bits set and becomes `198.18.0.0/15`; `https://wiki.example.com/page` is a URL and becomes `wiki.example.com`. A repeated line is an error too.
- **Warnings** do not block saving; they ask for a second look: the range includes the cloud metadata address `169.254.169.254`, includes loopback, is very broad (shorter than /8 for IPv4 or /16 for IPv6), or is public (public addresses are reachable anyway, so the line changes nothing).
Emptying a list and saving stores an explicit empty list, which revokes every inherited exception. That is not the same as Reset.

You can also configure the plugin row in the Profile's `cordis.patch.yml`; see [examples/allowlist.cordis.yml](examples/allowlist.cordis.yml):

```yaml
- id: web-fetch-enhanced
  config:
    allowCidrs:
      - 198.18.0.0/15

A patch replaces the row's whole `config`, so restate every field you want to keep. Every field, default, and rule is described in the [configuration reference](docs/configuration.zh-CN.md) (Chinese).

- The plugin registers one fetch provider in `ctx.web` with the id `http`, taking the native provider's seat; the `web` row's existing `fetchProvider: http` therefore selects it.
- Each request reads one configuration snapshot and runs through the official `HttpFetchProvider` from `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-fetch-http`. URL rules, same-origin redirects, proxy routing, connection pinning, timeouts, size caps, and MIME / charset handling are upstream code.
- The plugin replaces only its DNS resolution: resolve once, check every answer. Public addresses pass; a non-public address must fall inside a CIDR and, when hostname rules exist, belong to a matching hostname. If any answer fails, the whole request is refused. IPv4 addresses reached through NAT64 are checked too.
- The validated address set is what the connection uses; the hostname is not resolved again after the check.
- When CIDRs are configured and this plugin serves `web_fetch`, it gives the model a runtime context naming the approved ranges and hostnames, so the model does not refuse intranet URLs up front.

- DSH: `>=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0-0`. 0.2.0-rc.2 is no longer supported; stay on 0.0.12 for that version.
- Node.js: `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`.
- Only DSH release candidates and stable releases are supported. Alpha builds and development snapshots change too often and carry no stable API, so they are not targeted.
- The DSH 0.3 series will be evaluated before the upper bound moves.

The plugin page says web_fetch is served by "deepseek-fetch-api" "Use the new Web Search API" is on under **Plugins → Built-in plugin settings → Web search**. That switch routes `web_fetch` to the DeepSeek Fetch API, so this plugin's settings have no effect. Turn it off to switch back to `http`, which is this plugin. The DeepSeek Search / Fetch API itself is unaffected by this plugin.
web_search or web_fetch fails with WEB_PROVIDER_AMBIGUOUS

The `web` row lost `searchProvider` or `fetchProvider`. A patch replaces a row's whole `config`: a patch that writes one field drops the other, and the missing one falls back to automatic selection. DSH 0.2.1 mounts the DeepSeek Search / Fetch API providers by default and they are always available, so automatic selection finds several candidates and fails. The 0.0.12 bundle patch broke `web_search` exactly this way.

Fix: upgrade to 0.1.0, which no longer rewrites the `web` row; run `dsh --profile web --dump-config`, find the patch that writes only one field of `web`, and restate both. As a temporary workaround, set `DSH_WEB_SEARCH_PROVIDER` / `DSH_WEB_FETCH_PROVIDER`.
After upgrading, web_fetch fails with WEB_PROVIDER_CONFIGURED_MISSING

0.1.0 registers as `http` by default instead of `http-enhanced`. If your Profile still carries `web.fetchProvider: http-enhanced` or `providerId: http-enhanced` on the plugin row, remove those overrides; if you need `http-enhanced`, use the coexistence setup below.
Why does *.example.com not match example.com? Wildcard rules match subdomains only. To allow both, list `example.com` and `*.example.com`.

Why is a cross-site redirect refused? Only same-origin redirects (same scheme, host, and port) are followed, each hop checked again. A cross-origin redirect fails with `WEB_REDIRECT_BLOCKED`; the agent fetches the new URL in a separate call, so trust in one target never carries over to another site.
Can I keep the native provider next to this plugin?

Yes, but only when something must keep using the native `http` provider. See [examples/coexist.cordis.yml](examples/coexist.cordis.yml): the plugin uses `providerId: http-enhanced`, `web-fetch-http` is re-enabled, and the `web` row states both `searchProvider` and `fetchProvider`. Two providers cannot register the same id; that fails at startup with `WEB_DUPLICATE_PROVIDER`.
Does the allowlist still apply with an HTTP proxy configured?

A request routed through a proxy has its hostname resolved by the proxy and gets no local DNS check, exactly as with the native provider. The allowlist applies to direct requests and to IP literals. When the URL host is an IP literal, the plugin checks it first: a non-public address outside the allowlist is refused and never reaches the proxy.
</details>
